Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. is a trusted chemical supplier based in Baroda (Vadodara), Gujarat, India, serving industrial and commercial customers with a broad portfolio of acids, alkalis, solvents, and specialty chemicals. Conveniently located at 102, Sudhan Apartment, Opp. Tejas School, Race Course, Baroda-7, the company combines local responsiveness with dependable nationwide sourcing to support manufacturers across sectors such as pharmaceuticals, dyes and pigments, textiles, water treatment, metal finishing, and general engineering.

Built on a commitment to reliability, safety, and value, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. focuses on delivering consistent product quality, timely logistics, and attentive technical service. The team emphasizes responsible handling and storage practices, transparent documentation, and compliance with applicable regulations, helping customers meet their own quality and EHS requirements. Whether the need is for commodity acids and bases, high-purity solvents, or customized blends and pack sizes, the company strives to tailor solutions to each client’s process and performance targets.

With an emphasis on long-term partnerships, Minol prioritizes clear communication, fair pricing, and post-delivery support. Its location in the Race Course area of Baroda provides excellent access to the region’s industrial corridors and transport networks, enabling efficient dispatch and responsive service. From initial inquiry to fulfillment, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. works to simplify procurement, reduce downtime, and ensure a reliable supply chain for critical inputs.

Customers and partners can expect a professional, safety-conscious approach, pragmatic problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. By aligning product availability, quality assurance, and customer-centric service, Minol Acid And Chemicals P. Ltd. aims to be a dependable ally in the growth and operational excellence of India’s manufacturing ecosystem.
